consequence.statement: Certificate renewal timing now has a randomized offset of approximately +/- 15 minutes around the 12-hour renewal by default, instead of all proxies renewing simultaneously.

assertion.statement: Istio adds the env var SECRET_GRACE_PERIOD_RATIO_JITTER (default 0.01), which randomizes certificate renewal timing by about +/- 15 minutes around the 12-hour renewal.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for env-var added
